第73 章 出发大东北-《穿越60带着空间当保安》

王野出门直奔供销社，吃的他不缺，缺的是合理的拿出来。到地方王野没废话，直接要十个饭盒，又买了一套锅碗瓢盆。虽然售货员很好奇王野为什么买这么多，但是看着王野手里的票据也没多问。

不是他不想问，而是王野腰里挎着大黑星呢。王野背着东西直奔城外，找了一个人迹罕见的地方取出空间里取出卤肉的大锅。

先装五盒卤肉，空间中的馒头不多了。支上锅，开始蒸馒头，这次王野要一次到位直接蒸了两大笼屉。想起早上的大包子，王野又蒸上了一屉肉包子。

这个就是有空间辅助，要是王野自己那得费老劲儿了。一直到十点来钟，王野开始盘点自己还缺什么。

干粮有了，菜有了。坐火车呀，对于一个后世人零食怎么能少。王野又炒了半锅花生，其实王野更喜欢瓜子，可是他还没有找到种子。

昨天买种子的时候王野也没有找到，可能是没找对地方。现在先凑合一下吧，有花生吃也不错。

就在王野要回去的时候，想起了一件很重要的事，还没有给箱子装这些东西呀。王野精神力进入空间，看见好多毛竹，这是当初在院子里收的，利用精神力很快就做了一类似后世的竹行李箱。

看着自己的杰作王野心想：“这要是在后世有空间的加成相信过的会更好。”

把箱子绑在后架上，王野直奔工厂。在门口吴志强正在焦急的等着，王野骑车到吴志强的跟前才停下问道：“师父，这么客气呀，还在这儿等我？”

吴志强笑骂道：“看你小子脸大的，我还等你，是你赵爷爷罚我呢，他说你不回来不让我动。”

王野好奇的问：“师父，你又怎么惹到赵爷爷了？”

吴志强声调都提高了三分：“还不是因为你小子，你赵爷爷问我你干什么去了，我就一五一十的说了。”

王野说：“师父有人说过你很实在吗？”

吴志强疑惑问道：“有啊，还挺多，怎么了？”

王野憋着笑：“没怎么，挺好，人家夸你呢。”说完王野就把车子支上跑进门卫室了。

没一会儿吴志强就叫着王野和孙叔去了办公室，一进屋吴志强就从抽屉里拿出四张票据递给王野和孙叔说道：“这是四斤全国粮票，你俩一人两斤，算是这次出差的补助。”

王野撇着嘴：“师父，咱这么大个厂子这么抠儿呀，就给二斤，喂猫呢？”

吴志强敲着桌子：“你小子还不知足，你信不信，我说这次出差补助二斤全国粮票，就科里那些小子能打起来。”

吴志强说的没错，现在的全国粮票可是好东西，一般想要点儿什么都可以用全国粮票换。如果你有足够的全国粮票，就是去买自行车，售货员都给你想办法调换成自行车票。

吴志强说完又从身后的柜子里拿出两把长枪，递给两人：“这是今天刚送来的，好东西，56半，你俩可给我爱惜点儿，这次就给了二十把。”

王野和孙叔拿到枪都开始摆弄起来，没两下就要熟练了。吴志强又从抽屉里拿出一盒子弹：“这盒子弹你俩分分，等会儿车队的人会送你们去车站。”

Wang Ye went straight to the supply and marketing cooperative when he went out. He didn't lack food, but what he lacked was provided in a reasonable amount.When he arrived at the place, Wang Ye didn't waste any time and asked for ten lunch boxes and bought a set of pots and pans.Although the salesperson was curious about why Wang Ye bought so much, he looked at the receipt in Wang Ye's hand and didn't ask any more questions.

It's not that he doesn't want to ask, but Wang Ye has a big black star on his waist.Wang Ye carried his things and headed straight outside the city, found a place rarely visited by people, and took out the big pot of braised pork from the space.

First, pack five boxes of braised pork. There are not many steamed buns left in the space.He put on the pot and started steaming the steamed buns. This time, Wang Ye steamed two large steamers at once.Thinking of the big buns in the morning, Wang Ye steamed another drawer of meat buns.

This is supported by space. It would have been a lot of effort for Wang Ye himself.Until ten o'clock, Wang Ye began to take stock of what he still lacked.

There is dry food and vegetables.Taking a train, how can a person from this generation not have enough snacks?Wang Ye fried another half of the pot of peanuts. In fact, Wang Ye preferred melon seeds, but he hadn't found the seeds yet.

When Wang Ye bought the seeds yesterday, he didn't find them either. Maybe he didn't look for them in the right place.Let's make do with it for now, it's not bad to have peanuts.

Just when Wang Ye was about to go back, he remembered something very important. He hadn't packed these things in the box yet.Wang Ye entered the space with his mental power and saw a lot of moso bamboo, which he had collected in the yard. He used his mental power to quickly make a bamboo suitcase similar to that of later generations.

Looking at his masterpiece, Wang Ye thought: "I believe it will be better if there is room for bonuses in future generations."

After tying the box to the back rack, Wang Ye went straight to the factory.Wu Zhiqiang was waiting anxiously at the door. Wang Ye rode his bicycle to Wu Zhiqiang before stopping and asked: "Master, you are so polite, are you still waiting for me here?"

Wu Zhiqiang laughed and scolded: "Look at your big face, I'm still waiting for you. It was your Grandpa Zhao who punished me. He said he wouldn't let me move until you come back."

Wang Ye asked curiously: "Master, how did you provoke Grandpa Zhao again?"

Wu Zhiqiang's tone increased by three points: "It's not because of you, kid. Your Grandpa Zhao asked me what you were doing, so I told you exactly."

Wang Ye said: "Master, has anyone ever said that you are very down-to-earth?"

Wu Zhiqiang asked in confusion: "Yes, there are quite a few. What's wrong?"

Wang Ye suppressed a smile: "Nothing, it's good, people praise you." After saying that, Wang Ye put up the car and ran into the guard room.

After a while, Wu Zhiqiang called Wang Ye and Uncle Sun to the office. As soon as he entered the room, Wu Zhiqiang took out four bills from the drawer and handed them to Wang Ye and Uncle Sun, saying: "These are four kilograms of national food stamps. Each of you two has two kilograms. It is considered as a subsidy for this business trip."

Wang Ye curled his lips and said, "Master, a factory like ours is so picky, so I only give you two kilograms to feed the cat?"

Wu Zhiqiang knocked on the table: "You kid is not satisfied yet. Believe it or not, I said that this business trip will be subsidized with two kilograms of national food stamps. Only those guys in Corey can fight."

Wu Zhiqiang is right. Today's national food stamps are a good thing. Generally, you can use national food stamps to exchange for anything you want.If you have enough national food stamps, even if you go to buy a bicycle, the salesperson will find a way to exchange them for bicycle tickets.

After Wu Zhiqiang finished speaking, he took out two long guns from the cabinet behind him and handed them to the two of them: "These are just delivered today. They are good things. They are 56 and a half. You two should take good care of them. I will give you twenty this time."

When Wang Ye and Uncle Sun got the guns, they started playing with them, and they became proficient in them within a few strokes.Wu Zhiqiang took out another box of bullets from the drawer: "You two share this box of bullets. The people from the motorcade will take you to the station later."
